title: Content schema
description: The form of a content schema file: the schema of the content of one artifact kind or one item kind at one version.

$id.description: The level, the kind and the version, as in artifacts/persona_catalog/v1.

title.description: The name of the kind as shown to the user.

x-key-prefix.description: Item kinds only. The prefix of the key of an item, such as REQ, or a short text that names one prefix for each case, as backlog_item does. A kind whose key is built another way has none.

x-ui-navigable.description: Item kinds only. Whether the items of the kind can be reached one by one: a row in the outline of the document that holds them, and a page of their own. Items short enough to read in place in the page of the document, such as the messages of an interview, are not navigable.

x-ui-title-field.description: Item kinds only. The field that names an item in lists, links, the outline and trace views.

x-ui-role-field.description: Item kinds only. The field whose value is the key of the participant who says the words of a message, shown as the speaker of a transcript. The kinds that draw a transcript name one.

x-ui-participants-field.description: Artifact kinds only. The field that lists the people of a conversation, the one who leads first: an object list whose entries have key, name, role and item_id. A message names its speaker by the key of an entry. The kinds that draw a transcript name one.

x-ui-list-fields.description: Item kinds only. The fields shown as table columns, on a card, and on the card of a profile: the fields that read on one line under its title, then the others.

x-ui-field-order.description: Every property name, in the order of the detail view and the edit form.

title.description: The label of the field as shown to the user.

type.description: A single type, or a list that adds null for an optional field.

x-ui-label-field.description: Of a rating-list: the field of an entry that names what is rated.

x-ui-value-field.description: Of a rating-list: the integer field of an entry that holds the rating; its minimum and maximum give the scale.

x-ui-note-field.description: Of a rating-list: the field of an entry that says why, shown under the rating.

x-value-list.description: The key of a value list of the workflow definition that gives the allowed values.

x-value-from.description: The artifact kind and the field, joined by a dot, that give the allowed values.
